newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ross sets one for seven rights issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ross sets one for seven rights issue.

text.p: Gold miner Ross Mining NL said on Thursday it planned to make a one for seven rights issue at A$1.10 per share to raise A$23.6 million.

Ross Mining said the funds raised by the issue would assist in the development and construction of gold mining facilities at the Gold Ridge project in the Solomon Islands and the Timbarra gold project in northern New South Wales.
The company was also advanced in securing a mixture of project finance and corporate debt to further assist in funding requirements.
These two projects, in conjunction with production from existing operations at Yandan, would take Ross Mining's yearly gold production from the current 86,000 ounces to 150,000 ounces or more.

"The directors of Ross Mining anticipate that this higher level of production can be maintained for a period of at least 1O years, ignoring any new acquisitions or exploration success," the company said.
Ross Mining said it expected that construction of the Gold Ridge gold mining facilities would start in March 1997 and that first gold would be poured 12 months later.
All agreements necessary to allow construction to start have been agreed, in principle, between Ross Mining, Gold Ridge Landowners and the Solomon Islands Government.
